views.label: Foundations to correlation
views.note: Acquire only the security concepts required to build the deterministic core.

views.label: Incident and ATT&CK
views.note: Turn evidence into a case, then attach evidence-backed ATT&CK meaning.

views.label: Grounded AI support
views.note: Reuse AI skills only after deterministic security facts exist.

cards.title: Phase 0–1 • Events
items: Learning node: 30 min; outcome — ‘I can explain Event vs Alert vs Incident’; do not overlearn SIEM products.
What: model safe fixture inputs; Input: raw examples; Output: RawEvent fixtures.
Knowledge: SOC, SIEM/EDR roles, Event vs Alert vs Incident, auth/process/network logs.
Learn before: read one event of each type; Later — Future Extension: real SIEM/EDR APIs; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Phase 2 • Normalizer
items: Learning node: 2 h; outcome — ‘I can explain core fields, process parentage, network direction, and ordering’; do not overlearn full schemas.
What: preserve meaning in a common schema; Input: RawEvent; Output: NormalizedEvent.
Knowledge: security fields, process trees, network direction, timestamps.
Learn before: field semantics; Later — Future Extension: ECS/OCSF; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Phase 3 • Detection
items: Learning node: 2 h; outcome — ‘I can explain rule, threshold, IOC, FP, and FN’; do not overlearn ML.
What: deterministic suspicious-behavior rules; Input: NormalizedEvent; Output: Detection/Alert.
Knowledge: thresholds, IOC vs TTP, FP/FN, brute force, contextual PowerShell.
Learn before: tune golden/benign cases; Later — Future Extension: Sigma/YARA/ML; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Phase 4 • Correlation
items: Learning node: half day; outcome — ‘I can explain and justify evidence links’; do not overlearn graph databases.
What: connect evidence into a likely case; Input: events + detections; Output: correlated group/create-update decision.
Knowledge: time/entity/process/IOC links and evidence.
Learn before: justify a correlation score; Later — Future Extension: graphs/probabilistic models; Depth: Intermediate.

cards.title: Phase 5 • Incident
items: Learning node: 1 h; outcome — ‘I can explain lifecycle, triage, and severity’; do not overlearn full incident response.
What: represent a triageable case; Input: related evidence; Output: Incident + timeline.
Knowledge: lifecycle, triage, severity vs confidence, fact vs hypothesis.
Learn before: preserve evidence IDs; Later — Future Extension: full IR playbooks; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Phase 6 • ATT&CK
items: Learning node: 2 h; outcome — ‘I can explain tactic, technique, sub-technique, and TTP’; do not memorize the matrix.
What: map evidenced behavior; Input: detections/behavior; Output: technique IDs + evidence links.
Knowledge: tactic, technique, sub-technique, TTP.
Learn before: map T1110/T1059.001 deterministically; Later — Future Extension: broad coverage; Depth: Beginner–Basic.

cards.title: Phase 7 • RAG
items: Learning node: 1 h; outcome — ‘I can verify that a citation supports a claim’; do not rebuild known RAG fundamentals.
What: retrieve trusted guidance; Input: incident + technique IDs/entities; Output: cited chunks.
Knowledge: ATT&CK reading, trusted sources, traceability.
Learn before: verify citation support; Later — Future Extension: hybrid retrieval; Depth: Security Beginner.

cards.title: Phase 8 • Copilot
items: Learning node: 2 h; outcome — ‘I can separate evidence, finding, and hypothesis’; do not overlearn advanced playbooks.
What: draft a grounded investigation report; Input: incident/evidence/timeline/mappings/chunks; Output: structured draft.
Knowledge: SOC questions, evidence vs hypothesis, IOC/TTP use.
Learn before: label uncertainty; Later — Future Extension: multi-agent SOC/remediation; Depth: Security Basic.

cards.title: Phase 9 • Evaluation
items: Learning node: half day; outcome — ‘I can test expected, benign, and insufficient-evidence outcomes’; do not overlearn production observability.
What: prove deterministic accuracy and grounded output; Input: golden, benign, and missing-evidence scenarios; Output: metrics/failures.
Knowledge: FP/FN, evidence traceability, unsupported-claim detection.
Learn before: define expected outcomes; Later — Future Extension: production telemetry; Depth: Basic.
